detail.reason:
Audit complete: comment spec command surface vs shipped CLI. Verdicts - Commands and syntax: MATCH. Immutability of comment bodies: MATCH. Author attribution: MATCH. Help/man/capabilities: DIVERGENCE on one minor clause (noun-level long_about has all four required content elements plus a synopsis but no literal EXAMPLES block; dominant noun-level house style agrees with the implementation - 10 of 12 subcommand-bearing nouns also lack it); spec-side amendment text for the reconciliation child is written in full in the bead notes. No implementation-bug proposal opened; no source changes in this child. Full per-section evidence (actual invocations, outputs, store checks) on the bead notes.

Checklist evidence:
1. git status --short before closing: no changes owned by this child (verification-only audit; shared tree untouched, probe artifacts confined to /data/build/scratch/tmp-beadrs-744833ad and /build/bead-rs/audit-744833ad).
2. Repository definition of done in a clean extraction: HEAD == origin/main == 6878c2ae (verified at dispatch start; this child made no commits), extracted via git archive to /data/build/scratch/beadrs-744833ad-audit; scripts/definition-of-done.sh --fast there => PASS: fmt + test (1139+ tests, 0 failures).
3. Acceptance criteria: (1) probes ran only in the extraction/private target/throwaway dirs; live .beads store untouched by probes - probe commands that were absorbed by the pre-existing /data/build/scratch ancestor workspace were closed out as self-describing scratch junk (bead-6d4ea22d). (2) Per-section verdicts recorded on the bead via update --notes during this dispatch. (3) The one DIVERGENCE is owned via option (a): full amendment text in notes. (4) No source changes; notes rollup is the deliverable.
4. Nothing to push: zero commits by this child; git rev-list origin/main..HEAD is empty.

```verified:
scripts/definition-of-done.sh --fast exit=0
```

Audit complete against clean git-archive origin/main HEAD 6878c2ae; no source changes and no divergence found.

Definitions: PASS. Native IDs, explicit unresolved state, immutable/verbatim body storage, actor ladder, padded actor preservation, and canonical projection order matched the spec.
Validation rules: PASS for V1-V9 exercised. Empty, over-cap, invalid UTF-8, missing file, malformed/missing/cross-issue selectors, actor cap, actor fallback, and selector precedence returned the specified exit classes with no comment rows/events/checkpoint records on failure. V10 collision exhaustion was not injectable; generated IDs were unique. Unknown actor was accepted as required by the no-identity-provider definition.
Audit events/event schema: PASS. Observed SQLite events: sequence 3 comment_added (alice, {comment_id: comment-8bf2740e}); 4 comment_added (bob, {comment_id: comment-70c0fac1, reply_to_id: comment-8bf2740e}); 5 comment_resolved (carol, {comment_id: comment-8bf2740e}); 6 comment_unresolved (erin, {comment_id: comment-8bf2740e}); later body-file create was sequence 7 comment_added. Checkpoint current/forensic/object records carried the same kinds/details using origin_event_sequence. Double-resolve was exit 0, semantic_change false, and did not advance the sequence.
Revision/fencing: PASS. Parent revision stayed 1 across comment writes. Comment --if-revision and --fencing-token were rejected with exit 2. An issue update at revision 1 succeeded and the second stale --if-revision 1 write returned exit 4 with Revision mismatch.
Exact audit probe invocations and full per-section evidence are recorded in bead notes. The isolated probe workspace and clean source extraction were removed. An initial child under /data/build/scratch discovered a pre-existing parent store and accidentally created bead-0066ec4c and bead-ad1d2ab3 before isolation was detected; no comment probes ran there, it was not altered/deleted, and the incident is documented in notes.

Checklist: status was inspected before any staging; no task-owned source changes existed, so no commit was made. Clean HEAD extraction ran definition-of-done --fast successfully and was removed. git push on main exited 0 and origin/main..HEAD was empty. bead sync flush-only confirmed the checkpoint current.

Completed the machine-interface audit against origin/main 6878c2ae using a clean git-archive binary and disposable workspaces. No source, test, config, or documentation changes were made; no commit was manufactured. The required bead notes contain per-section verdicts, a reproducible/not-reproducible row for all 12 conformance scenarios, and full spec-side amendment text for every observed divergence.

Result: envelope/output behavior passed. Secret scanning passed for atomic native/org rejection, value-free diagnostics, advisory/off modes, exact acknowledgment, checkpoint recovery, and quarantine gating, with the documented exit-code and advisory-audit divergences recorded in notes. Exit-code probes covered usage 2, missing selector/workspace 3, target/quarantine conflict 4, transport I/O 1, secret rejection 2, and SQLite contention 1. Scenario 12’s quarantine subcase was reproduced; the interrupted maintenance-hold subcase was explicitly recorded as not reproducible without manufacturing an interrupted redaction state.

Verification: the clean committed HEAD extraction ran scripts/definition-of-done.sh --fast successfully (fmt, full test suite, doctests); the extraction was removed afterward. git status was checked before any staging; all pre-existing dirty source/untracked paths were preserved and not staged or committed. git push reported Everything up-to-date, and git rev-list origin/main..HEAD was empty. The owned archive and disposable audit workspaces were removed.
